name: ANSI/IEEE Solenoid valve actuator form
summary: IEEE-library form of solenoid valve actuator: this representation identifies the electrical actuator associated with a solenoid-operated valve.
description: This reference locates solenoid valve actuator in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented solenoids family. This representation identifies the electrical actuator associated with a solenoid-operated valve. The public library uses HSV1 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
